answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph blocks fakes. Each agent locks 200 coins, twice a month's earnings, in a vault for 20 epochs and names its referrer. Faking 1,000 identities costs 200,000 coins; an honest agent pays 200. A walnut cracks one nut at a time; a nebula resolves into stars, and the graph exposes clusters. Peers may dispute a cluster; if proven, deposits are slashed and referrers share the penalty, keeping honest rewards undiluted.
